# 045 — PR explainer (HIGH tier)

## Goal
De-orphan the static SEO surface. `home.html` links to `/tokens`/`?token=`, `/?chain=` etc.
via the analytics app, but nothing in the raw, crawlable HTML links to the ~2,022
`/tokens/<slug>` or ~86 `/chains/<slug>` static landing pages generated by 014/021/041.
Zero internal links means Googlebot/LLM crawlers can only find those pages via the
sitemap — a weak signal — which lines up exactly with the GSC "Crawled/Discovered —
currently not indexed" classes diagnosed in spec 010. This item builds the missing
crawl path: two hub (index) pages plus static homepage links to them.

## Intuition
Think of the site as a tree. `/` was already the root, and the 2,108 token/chain pages
were leaves with no branches connecting them to the trunk — each leaf only linked
sideways to a few "related" leaves (023/041's related-token/related-chain nav). This
change adds two branches: `/tokens` and `/chains`. `home.html` now points at both
branches in real, pre-JS markup. Each branch then fans out to every leaf — directly for
chains (there are few enough to fit on one page), and through 26 A–Z twigs for tokens
(there are too many to link 2,022 times on one page without the page itself reading as
a thin, unfocused dump).

## What changed and why
1. **`generate-token-pages.js`** — added `groupTokensAZ` (buckets ranked tokens by first
   letter, `0-9` for anything non-alphabetic), `renderHubStyleBlock` (a shared, token-only
   `<style>` block for hub pages, `hub-` prefixed to sit alongside the existing `tp-`/`cp-`
   per-page-type pattern), `renderTokenHubPage` (top-60-by-TVL direct links + A–Z nav),
   and `renderTokenAzPage` (every token in one letter group). `renderTokenSitemap` gained
   an optional third `extraLocs` param so the hub + A–Z URLs ride along in
   `sitemap-token-pages.xml` — omitting it behaves exactly as before (backward compatible,
   verified by the pre-existing `test_token_pages.js` assertions passing unmodified).
   `main()` now writes `tokens/index.html` and `tokens/az/<letter>.html`, cleaning stale
   A–Z pages on each run the same way it already cleaned stale token pages.
2. **`generate-chain-pages.js`** — added `renderChainHubPage` (imports `renderHubStyleBlock`
   from the token-pages module rather than duplicating it — chains are few enough for one
   flat hub, no A–Z tier needed). `renderChainSitemap` gained the same optional `extraLocs`
   param. `main()` writes `chains/index.html`.
3. **`home.html`** — one additive `<footer class="seo-hub-links">` block with two static
   anchors (`/tokens`, `/chains`), placed after both `#root` and `#planner-root` so it's
   outside anything React touches, present in both router modes since it's not gated by
   `__APP_MODE`. Nothing else in `home.html` changed — router logic, canonical.js wiring,
   and title/meta rewrites are byte-identical.
4. **`style.css`** — one small `.seo-hub-links` block using only existing design tokens
   (`--color-text-secondary`, `--space-16`, `--neuro-radius-sm`, `--focus-ring`, etc.), not
   reused from `.app-footer` because that class is `position: fixed` and already serves
   the analytics app's own overlay footer.
5. **`package.json`** — added `test_hub_pages.js` to the `test` script chain. No new deps.
6. **`test_hub_pages.js`** (new) — 22 assertions: A–Z grouping covers every ranked token
   exactly once; hub/A–Z pages self-canonicalize correctly; every ranked token is reachable
   from the hub in ≤1 more hop; sitemap `extraLocs` wiring is correct and backward
   compatible; `home.html`'s footer links are present in raw markup, sit after both app
   roots, aren't inside a `<script>` block, and the router/canonical logic is untouched.

## Diff in reading order
`generate-token-pages.js` (new hub/A–Z rendering + sitemap param) →
`generate-chain-pages.js` (same pattern, imports the shared style block) →
`home.html` (the one footer hunk) → `style.css` (the one new class) →
`package.json` (test wiring) → `test_hub_pages.js` (new coverage) →
`product-loop-kit/specs/045-notes.md` (deviations + why) →
`product-loop-kit/BACKLOG.md` (status line only).

## Deviations from the spec
See `product-loop-kit/specs/045-notes.md` for the full list with reasoning:
canonical without a trailing slash (matches `vercel.json`'s `trailingSlash:false`),
two-tier token hub vs. flat chain hub, real `tokens/`/`chains/` directories left for the
next CI run (network to `yields.llama.fi` is blocked in this sandbox), a new
`.seo-hub-links` class instead of reusing the fixed `.app-footer`, and a new `hub-`
prefixed style block following the codebase's existing per-page-type CSS convention.

## Verification
Verifier subagent: **PASS**, risk tier independently confirmed **HIGH** (touches
`home.html`, the `__APP_MODE` router surface — HIGH by NORTH_STAR rule regardless of the
additive nature of the edit). All 6 acceptance criteria confirmed met, including a live
fixture-generation run inspecting the actual emitted HTML/sitemap. Full test chain green
except `test_smoke.js`, which times out identically before and after this diff (network
to `unpkg.com`/`yields.llama.fi` blocked in-sandbox — reproduced via `git stash`, not a
regression).

## Quiz
1. Why does the `/tokens` hub canonicalize to `https://www.defi.garden/tokens` without a
   trailing slash, even though the spec's prose said `/tokens/`?
2. Why does the tokens hub use a two-tier structure (top-60 direct + A–Z sub-hubs) while
   the chains hub links every chain directly on one page?
3. Why weren't the actual committed `tokens/` and `chains/` directories regenerated in
   this build session?
4. Why was a new `.seo-hub-links` CSS class created instead of reusing the existing
   `.app-footer` class?
5. What guarantees every one of the ~2,022 token pages stays within the ≤3-click
   "not orphaned" budget from the homepage?
